Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring record checks for fire fighters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fire fighter record checks; adding a new sectionto chapter 41.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 52.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For all paid or volunteer fire fighters that may, in the courseof their work or volunteer activity for a city, have access to the homeor property of another person, cities shall require a record checkthrough the Washington state patrol criminal identification systemunder RCW 43.43.830 through 43.43.834, 10.97.030, and 10.97.050 andthrough the federal bureau of investigation before hiring an employeeor accepting a volunteer. The record check shall include a fingerprintcheck using a complete Washington state criminal identificationfingerprint card. The requesting entity shall provide a copy of therecord report to the applicant or volunteer. When necessary, asdetermined by the city, applicants and volunteers may be employed on aconditional basis pending completion of the investigation. If theapplicant has had a record check within the previous twelve months, thecity may waive the requirement upon receiving a copy of the record from p. 1 SB 6441the applicant or volunteer. The city may in its discretion requirethat the applicant or volunteer pay the costs associated with therecord check. (2) Record checks shall not be required of persons who are paid orvolunteer fire fighters of the city prior to the effective date of thisact.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 52.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For all employees or volunteers that may, in the course oftheir work or volunteer activity with the district, have access to thehome or property of another person, fire protection districts shallrequire a record check through the Washington state patrol criminalidentification system under RCW 43.43.830 through 43.43.834, 10.97.030,and 10.97.050 and through the federal bureau of investigation beforehiring an employee or accepting a volunteer. The record check shallinclude a fingerprint check using a complete Washington state criminalidentification fingerprint card. The requesting entity shall providea copy of the record report to the applicant or volunteer. Whennecessary, as determined by the fire protection district, applicantsand volunteers may be employed on a conditional basis pendingcompletion of the investigation. If the applicant has had a recordcheck within the previous twelve months, the fire protection districtmay waive the requirement upon receiving a copy of the record from theapplicant or volunteer. The fire protection district may in itsdiscretion require that the applicant or volunteer pay the costsassociated with the record check. (2) Record checks shall not be required of persons who are paid orvolunteer fire fighters of the fire protection district prior to theeffective date of this act.
